source_scope.authoritative_document: DWD_DWM语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.scope_rule: This slice covers candidate assets without an authoritative ODS domain that have a same-name CREATE in the DWD/DWM document. Every object is classified as immutable fact, rebuildable current projection, transport bridge, exact-grain wide projection or rejected wrong-layer reference/source.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name CREATE plus canonical entities, exact grain, physical role, stable key, time/version, privacy/unit, reversal/deletion, authority and explicit defect corrections.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production source-to-fact and fact-to-projection reconciliation with exact denominators, stable watermarks/checkpoints, key/content digests, conservation checks, independent verification and zero unexplained differences.

order_payment_fulfillment_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable order, order-item, payment, benefit-allocation or fulfillment lifecycle fact; DWM uses one declared order/item as-of grain
metric_rules: header and item identities remain separate and conservation is checked
payment intent authorization capture failure refund and chargeback are distinct effects
benefit amount and funding party are immutable allocations
shipment package and tracking milestones never overwrite order history
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
wide rows preaggregate one-to-many facts before joining
order_payment_fulfillment_fact.security: Buyer, seller, address, logistics and payment data are purpose-bound and tokenized or redacted.
order_payment_fulfillment_fact.authority: Order, Payment, Promotion and Fulfillment retain authority; DWD/DWM is replayable evidence only.

aftersales_refund_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable after-sale case/line, refund effect, return shipment or benefit reversal; DWM uses exact case-line as-of grain
metric_rules: partial and multi-line returns are first-class
refund intent and captured refund effect are distinct
return logistics and merchandise refund money are separate
benefit reversal points to the original allocation
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
wide projections preaggregate refunds shipments and reversals before joining
aftersales_refund_fact.security: Return addresses, evidence, payment and actor identities are restricted and purpose-bound.
aftersales_refund_fact.authority: AfterSales, Payment, Return Fulfillment and Promotion own effects; analytical rows cannot settle refunds.

promotion_entitlement_fact.grain: one tenant, Principal, entitlement and immutable issuance/claim/redemption/return/funding effect
metric_rules: template/campaign definition and user entitlement are separate
each entitlement transition has a stable event id
claim and redemption bind to exact order/item when applicable
refund return reverses the original entitlement effect
subsidy funding names platform seller or other party
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
promotion_entitlement_fact.security: Principal and campaign targeting data are minimized; voucher codes and funding evidence are restricted.
promotion_entitlement_fact.authority: Promotion owns entitlement effects; DWD/DWM cannot issue, redeem or refund a coupon.

engagement_delivery_fact.grain: one tenant, canonical Principal and immutable favorite/reminder/notification/login event or delivery attempt
metric_rules: intent, delivery attempt, provider receipt and user engagement are distinct
favorite add/remove and reminder enable/disable remain events
consent and opt-out version are evaluated at delivery time
provider retries preserve one logical delivery identity
login observation never grants authentication or authorization
soft deletion does not fabricate missing history
engagement_delivery_fact.security: Contact endpoints, devices, IP and behavioral data are tokenized, minimized and retention-bound.
engagement_delivery_fact.authority: Engagement records behavior/delivery evidence; Identity and owning services retain access and business authority.

community_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable content, interaction, report, appeal, moderation or quality-review fact; DWM declares one content/case grain
metric_rules: content and interaction histories use stable event ids
report appeal machine review human review and final decision are distinct
accepted decisions bind policy/model/reviewer versions
counts and latest fields are projections rather than history
synthetic red-team identities are isolated from real users
DWM preaggregates all one-to-many interactions and reviews
community_fact.security: Content, messages, search, reports, media and actor identities are restricted with consent and retention controls.
community_fact.authority: Community/Moderation owns effects; AI and analytical facts cannot hide, ban, select or distribute content.

live_economy_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable live session, presence, gift, tip, recharge, commission or reversal fact
metric_rules: session entry/exit pairs define duration
gift quantity and monetary value are distinct
captured Payment and immutable Ledger entries prove money
refund chargeback and compensation are explicit reversals
commission points to exact funding and beneficiary
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
live_economy_fact.security: Viewer/creator identity and live content are restricted; financial instruments are tokenized.
live_economy_fact.authority: Engagement owns sessions, Payment/Ledger owns money and Commerce owns orders; DWD/DWM cannot settle.

customer_service_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable ticket, message, attachment, link, tag, review, AI signal or accepted attribution fact
metric_rules: ticket lifecycle is ordered and append-only
messages comments and attachments retain redacted evidence lineage
order and after-sale links use canonical keys
AI/keyword/anti-fraud outputs remain signals
quality review and problem attribution require accepted reviewer decisions
DWM preaggregates messages tags links and reviews before ticket joins
customer_service_fact.security: Customer content, attachment, contact and order context are purpose-bound, encrypted and redacted in broad analytics.
customer_service_fact.authority: Customer Service owns tickets and accepted attribution; Risk/AI owns signals only and DWD/DWM is read-only.

compensation_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable compensation claim, accepted decision, funding, payment or ledger effect
metric_rules: claim and accepted compensation are distinct
funding party and reason version are explicit
payment capture failure refund and reversal remain effects
ledger entries are append-only and balanceable
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
DWM never infers paid status from a mutable bill row
compensation_fact.security: Claim evidence, identity and payment references are restricted and tokenized.
compensation_fact.authority: Customer Service owns claim decisions, Payment/Ledger owns money; DWD/DWM cannot compensate.

catalog_listing_workflow_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable catalog/listing workflow attempt, operation, import/reject/result or review fact
metric_rules: SPU/style and SKU/variant identities remain separate
listing attempt and review decision are immutable
operator uses effective Principal/worker assignment
import files retain digest and source-row lineage
result snapshots do not erase operation history
salary/payroll is excluded from Catalog and general analytical access
catalog_listing_workflow_fact.security: Operator, file, review, payroll and supplier data are purpose-bound and least-privilege.
catalog_listing_workflow_fact.authority: Catalog and Listing own product/publish state, Quality owns review and Workforce owns payroll.

merchant_lifecycle_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable merchant/shop/legal-entity lifecycle, appeal, deposit, payout or offboarding fact
metric_rules: Merchant Shop and LegalEntity identities remain separate
onboarding appeal and offboarding are ordered decisions
deposit recharge and withdrawal are immutable ledger/payment effects
bank/legal identifiers are token references
money uses ISO currency and integer minor units
AI answers are advisory with model/source lineage
merchant_lifecycle_fact.security: Legal, bank, address, contact and operator data are vaulted or tokenized.
merchant_lifecycle_fact.authority: Merchant owns lifecycle, Payment/Ledger owns money and Listing owns sellability; DWD facts cannot enact effects.

metadata_operation_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable metadata definition/version, task run, lineage edge, DQC result or accepted governance operation
metric_rules: asset schema metric and datasource versions are distinct
task definition node and run instance are separate
lineage edges retain source/target version and provenance
DQC definition instance execution and result are separate
AI helper/governance output is a suggestion until accepted
DWM preaggregates run/check edges without multiplying rows
metadata_operation_fact.security: SQL, connection details, owners, task parameters and AI prompts are restricted; secrets stay in a vault.
metadata_operation_fact.authority: Metadata/Data Quality owns accepted definitions and results; AI and DWD/DWM cannot apply governance changes.

ai_workflow_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable application/workflow version, run, node execution, request or invocation attempt
metric_rules: definition and immutable workflow version are separate
run request node execution and provider attempt have stable distinct ids
retry timeout cancellation and success use versioned status semantics
request/response payloads retain restricted digests and evidence references
Kafka/Hive/Doris projections conserve source identity
DWM joins account/app/workflow versions effective at the attempt time
ai_workflow_fact.security: Prompts, responses, environment variables, passwords, API keys, IP and email are restricted; secrets are vault-only.
ai_workflow_fact.authority: AI Operations owns execution state; DWD/DWM observes and projects without running workflows.

metric_rules: Principal mapping never uses username as identity
input output and total token conservation is checked
quota ledger uses signed integer units
top-up money requires captured Payment and PricingVersion
Skill search download package and entitlement are separate
image generation retains model/prompt/result evidence without broad content exposure
token_marketplace_fact.security: Credentials, API tokens, prompts, images, search terms and Principal data are restricted; secret values are excluded.
token_marketplace_fact.authority: Token Platform owns usage/quota, Payment owns top-up and Marketplace owns Skill entitlement; DWD/DWM is evidence only.

operations_intelligence_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable engine invocation, metric observation, alert, collection, intelligence signal or model-attempt fact
metric_rules: request and retry identities are stable
metric units thresholds and policy versions are explicit
collection task result provider and payload digest are retained
alert delivery and accepted operation are distinct
model result and accepted intelligence/risk decision are distinct
realtime/Hive/Doris projections conserve event identity and replay checkpoints
operations_intelligence_fact.security: Engine parameters, SQL, alerts, third-party content, clue identity and model payloads are restricted.
operations_intelligence_fact.authority: Operations/Intelligence/Risk own accepted effects; DWD/DWM observations cannot enforce or notify by themselves.

warehouse_quality_fact.grain: one tenant and immutable inbound, outbound, quality, identification, AI attempt/feedback or accepted human-review fact
metric_rules: header line and physical operation identities remain separate
receipt or outbound observation never creates stock by itself
inventory effects require exact warehouse/location/SKU/lot/UOM ledger dimensions
AI request image/part/result/feedback bind model and policy versions
human review remains independent ground truth
DWM preaggregates operations and reviews at exact physical-operation grain
warehouse_quality_fact.security: Warehouse details, worker identity, images and quality evidence are restricted and purpose-bound.
warehouse_quality_fact.authority: Warehouse/WMS owns operations, Inventory owns balances, Quality owns accepted decisions and AI Operations owns attempts.

wrong_layer_dimension_reference.grain: one tenant, reference namespace/key and approved non-overlapping effective version
metric_rules: lookup versions are immutable
source aliases are not global keys
event-time selection is deterministic
cache state never erases versions
labels do not create effects
DWD/DWM only references approved versions
wrong_layer_dimension_reference.security: Reference ownership and restricted attributes remain least-privilege.
wrong_layer_dimension_reference.authority: Owning domains approve reference meanings; DIM/cache objects cannot become facts.

wrong_layer_raw_source.grain: one source topic/partition/offset and immutable raw change envelope
metric_rules: schema version and payload digest are retained
event and ingestion time are distinct
tenant/source identity is validated
replay is deterministic
poison/duplicate rows are auditable
only governed facts enter DWD/DWM
wrong_layer_raw_source.security: Raw payload and connector credentials are restricted; secrets remain external.
wrong_layer_raw_source.authority: ODS preserves raw evidence only and cannot define canonical fact semantics.
